title: I Wanna Be Your Girl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
sources: https://api.mangadex.org/manga?title=Kanojo ni Naritai Kimi to Boku (MangaDex metadata for title 39f09bc5-1cea-45a1-b0b2-e50f2175e0de)
premise: Akira, long out only to her childhood friend Hime, comes out publicly as a trans girl when the two start high school. When Akira is harassed for wearing the girls' uniform, Hime starts wearing the boys' uniform and defends her fiercely, but Hime's brashness begins to strain their friendship. The story also shows family resistance, such as Akira's father refusing to let her grow her hair.
life_message: Living as one's true self takes courage, and good allies listen as well as defend.
